title: National Portal of India
description: The single window access to information and services provided by various Indian government entities.

title: myScheme Portal
description: A platform that helps citizens discover eligible government schemes based on their demographics.

title: UIDAI Official Portal
description: Official website for Aadhaar card enrollment, updates, status checks, and e-download.

title: DigiLocker
description: A cloud-based platform for issuance and verification of documents & certificates digitally.

title: National Scholarship Portal
description: One-stop solution for student scholarships from central ministries and state governments.

title: PM Kisan Portal
description: Official portal for landholding farmers to check eligibility, register, and check installment status.

title: Passport Seva Kendra
description: Online registration and appointment booking for obtaining or renewing Indian passports.

title: Income Tax Department
description: Official e-filing portal for income tax returns, PAN links, and tax calculations.

title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: A portal for citizens to report cybercrimes online, especially crimes targeting women and children.

title: UMANG Web Portal
description: Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance, offering access to 1200+ services.

title: Sarathi Parivahan (RTO)
description: Ministry of Road Transport website for applying for Driving Licenses and Learner Licenses.

title: Udyam Registration Portal
description: Official portal for registering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) under MSME Ministry.

title: National Consumer Helpline
description: A grievance redressal portal where consumers can file complaints against businesses or services.

title: National Career Service
description: A portal matching job-seekers with employers, training institutes, and career counselors.

title: e-Shram Portal
description: National database of unorganized workers to facilitate social welfare schemes delivery.

title: Startup India
description: A flagship initiative of the Government of India to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation.

title: PM MUDRA Yojana Portal
description: Official portal describing collateral-free loans up to 10 Lakhs for micro-enterprises.

title: Central Vigilance Commission
description: An apex government body to address corruption and promote integrity in public administration.

title: Voter Service Portal (ECI)
description: Official portal of the Election Commission of India for voter registration and updates.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission Portal
description: Official portal detailing sanitation, waste management schemes, and household toilet subsidies.
